# dvgamerr.app

> The bilingual portfolio and resume of Kananek Thongkam (KEM), a Software Engineer based in Bangkok, Thailand.

The site is available in English and Thai. It covers professional experience, education, software projects, technical skills, coding activity, and public contact channels.

## Portfolio

- [English portfolio and resume](https://dvgamerr.app/index.md): Markdown version of the primary English-language profile.
- [Thai portfolio and resume](https://dvgamerr.app/th/index.md): Markdown version of the Thai-language profile.

## Profiles and source

- [GitHub profile](https://github.com/dvgamerr): Public repositories and engineering activity.
- [Portfolio source repository](https://github.com/dvgamerr-app/dvgamerr-app.github.io): Astro source code for this website.

## Optional

- [English website](https://dvgamerr.app/): Human-readable English portfolio.
- [Thai website](https://dvgamerr.app/th/): Human-readable Thai portfolio.
